name: Nekonade Distortion
original_name: 猫撫ディストーション
source:
Tatsuki’s imouto Kotoko is striken with an incurable disease and spends every day in her room reading books. He told himself not to enter her room to avoid giving her any stress. One night, he saw lots of shooting stars in the sky and wanted to let her know since she loved seeing pictures of stars and space. When Tatsuki opened her door, he found Kotoko without any vital signs. He blamed himself for causing her death.

On another day much later when the night sky was full of shooting stars just like that fateful day, he visited her room just like before. To his surprise, Kotoko was there. The next morning, his parents thought that Kotoko had never died, and for some reason, his pet cat turned into a catgirl. 

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/02/13/february-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
达树的妹妹琴子身患不治之症，每天都待在房间里读书。他告诫自己不要进入她的房间，以免给她带来任何压力。一天夜里，他看见天空中划过许多流星，便想告诉琴子，因为她很喜欢看星星与宇宙的图片。然而，当达树打开房门时，却发现琴子已经没有了生命迹象。他把她的死归咎于自己。

很久以后的一天，夜空如同那个命运攸关的日子一样布满流星，他再次走进了她的房间。出乎意料的是，琴子竟然就在那里。第二天早上，他的父母仿佛认为琴子从未死过；不知为何，他养的猫也变成了一名猫娘。

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/02/13/february-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
